mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate consistently reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) compresses real corporate profits and increases risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units in a 3-month window, it indicates a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST falls below 1400 in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate output and profits, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side contraction (INDPRO < 100 and falling), manufacturing output declines reduce corporate capacity utilization and profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 100 and falling, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
